mapper.sql: modules.id AS id, modules.module_type_id AS moduleTypeId, module_types.name AS moduleTypeName, modules.name AS name, modules.ordering AS ordering, modules.status AS status, modules.created AS created, CONCAT(IFNULL(creator.first_name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(creator.last_name, '')) AS createdBy, modules.modified AS modified, CONCAT(IFNULL(modifier.first_name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(modifier.last_name, '')) AS modifiedBy

FROM modules LEFT JOIN module_types ON module_types.id = modules.module_type_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = modules.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = modules.modified_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO modules ( module_type_id, name, ordering, created, created_by, status ) VALUES ( #{request.moduleTypeId}, #{request.name}, #{request.ordering}, NOW(), #{userId}, COALESCE(#{request.status}, 1) )
mapper.update: UPDATE modules SET module_type_id = COALESCE(#{request.moduleTypeId}, module_type_id), name = COALESCE(#{request.name}, name), ordering = COALESCE(#{request.ordering}, ordering), status = COALESCE(#{request.status}, status), modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{request.id} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT *, 0 AS checked FROM modules WHERE status = 1 AND module_type_id = #{id} ORDER BY ordering ASC

SELECT *, TRIM(TRAILING ')' FROM SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(name, '(', -1), ')', 1)) AS type, (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM permissions WHERE module_id = modules.id AND group_id = #{roleId} LIMIT 01) AS checked FROM modules WHERE status = 1 AND module_type_id = #{id} ORDER BY ordering ASC

SELECT *, TRIM(TRAILING ')' FROM SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(name, '(', -1), ')', 1)) AS type, (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM permissions WHERE module_id = modules.id AND group_id IN (SELECT group_id FROM user_groups WHERE user_id = #{userId}) LIMIT 01) AS checked FROM modules WHERE status = 1 AND module_type_id = #{id} ORDER BY ordering ASC
